result: Existing AWKP evidence manifest entries are converted to LegacyEvidenceRecord with status=legacy_partial and an explicit reason that v2 claim/subject/dependency/gate/policy/runtime/test/verifier bindings are absent.
safety_properties: The adapter does not compute or invent a full v2 fingerprint for legacy records.
The adapter preserves evidence_id, task_id, name, and sha256 from the historical manifest.
Malformed legacy entries fail closed with ValueError instead of being silently accepted.
